solution:
"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/unique-binary-search-trees-ii/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

95. Unique Binary Search Trees II

Given an integer n, return all the structurally unique BST's (binary search trees), which has exactly n nodes of unique values from 1 to n. Return the answer in any order.

Example 1:

Input: n = 3
Output: [[1,null,2,null,3],[1,null,3,2],[2,1,3],[3,1,null,null,2],[3,2,null,1]]

Example 2:

Input: n = 1
Output: [[1]]

Constraints:

    1 <= n <= 8
"""


class Solution:
    def generateTrees(self, n: int) -> List[Optional[TreeNode]]:
        if n == 0:
            return []

        def generate(start: int, end: int) -> List[Optional[TreeNode]]:
            if start > end:
                return [None]

            all_trees = []
            for root_val in range(start, end + 1):
                left_trees = generate(start, root_val - 1)
                right_trees = generate(root_val + 1, end)

                for left in left_trees:
                    for right in right_trees:
                        root = TreeNode(root_val)
                        root.left = left
                        root.right = right
                        all_trees.append(root)
            return all_trees

        return generate(1, n)


sol = Solution()


# For printing trees, we can print their level order traversal lists
def trees_to_list(trees: List[Optional[TreeNode]]) -> List[List[Optional[int]]]:
    return [get_level_order(tree) for tree in trees]


print(
    trees_to_list(sol.generateTrees(3))
)  # [[1, None, 2, None, 3], [1, None, 3, 2], [2, 1, 3], [3, 1, None, None, 2], [3, 2, None, 1]]

assert sorted(trees_to_list(sol.generateTrees(3))) == sorted(
    [
        [1, None, 2, None, 3],
        [1, None, 3, 2],
        [2, 1, 3],
        [3, 1, None, None, 2],
        [3, 2, None, 1],
    ]
)
assert trees_to_list(sol.generateTrees(1)) == [[1]]

assert len(sol.generateTrees(0)) == 0
assert len(sol.generateTrees(1)) == 1
assert len(sol.generateTrees(2)) == 2
assert len(sol.generateTrees(3)) == 5
assert len(sol.generateTrees(4)) == 14
assert len(sol.generateTrees(5)) == 42
assert len(sol.generateTrees(6)) == 132
assert len(sol.generateTrees(7)) == 429
assert len(sol.generateTrees(8)) == 1430
assert [len(get_level_order(t)) for t in sol.generateTrees(3)] == [5, 4, 3, 5, 4]
assert [len(get_level_order(t)) for t in sol.generateTrees(1)] == [1]
assert len(sol.generateTrees(8)) == 1430
